deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting regional cutover wave 3
• env: production
• tag: v2.3.0-rc3
• commit: abc1234
• regions: us -> eu -> apac
• plan: canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with health gates

alice: Kicking off now. Can folks watch the us canary logs and call out any error spikes? @dave_oncall you on deck for alerts?

ben: watching. I'll keep an eye on 504/502 rates and p50/p95 tail latencies.

deploy-bot: us canary start: 1919998800

carla: quick note — feature-flag `new-token-cache` remains OFF for this roll, we want the stable path.

ben: saw a small uptick in 95th around 1 minute in, looks like background KV compaction noise, not from serving layer. p95 +40ms, errors steady.

alice: good, keep monitoring. If errors >0.3% for 5m we abort and pin back to v2.3.0-rc2.

dave_oncall: I'm subscribed to alerts. no noisy deploy patterns yet.

deploy-bot: us canary success -> advanced to eu canary: 1919998850

ben: eu looks clean so far. rolling latency similar to us. no error increase.

carla: double-checking rollout config: rollout_policy: canary; canary_size: 5%; canary_duration: 10m; rollout_steps: [5,25,100]

alice: heads-up for apac: our behind-proxy edge pool has a slower cold-start profile, we'll watch warmup.

deploy-bot: eu canary success -> advanced to apac canary: 1919998880

ben: apac p95 initially high (cold starts) but stabilizing after warm caches. errors at 0.08%.

carla: adding a short wait to ensure autoscaler scaled pods in apac gateway: `sleep 120s` in the runbook.

deploy-bot: apac canary done, final rollout -> 100% in all regions: 1919998900

alice: promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: v2.3.0-rc3 deployed to production (all regions) at 1919998910

dave_oncall: all alerts green. marking post-deploy 30m-monitoring window.

ben: will run a quick smoke against the embeddings endpoint and a couple of heavy prompt paths.

carla: opening a quick release note: "v2.3.0-rc3: kernel selection improvements, KV-cache performance, bugfixes for batching logic". tagging internal changelog.

alice: thanks team. If anything odd pops up, we pin using the runbook command:
`deployctl pin --env production --tag v2.3.0-rc2 --reason "rollback due to regressions"`

deploy-bot: reminder: automatic rollback policy is enabled for service `infer-rt` (threshold 0.5% errors over 10m).
